title: Jesus... I Deleted The Message And Sent "Haha Nothing"
topic: she types a long honest message to her best friend, deletes it and sends "haha nothing"

bible.text: Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I typed a whole paragraph about how I feel. I deleted it and sent "haha nothing". 💬

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You deleted it letter by letter. I watched you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: She has her own problems. I'm too much.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're not too much for Me. Say it here first.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: What if it's just heavy and pointless?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Heavy is exactly what I'm asking for.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You don't carry it alone. Put the weight down here first.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend who says "haha nothing". What's the paragraph you never sent? 👇
